presets.name: drawn (classic)
presets.description: one group combining its shapes by union, as a classic drawn mask did

presets.name: parametric (classic)
presets.description:
one group multiplying its parametric channels together, as a classic
parametric mask did

notes: add one parametric channel per property to select on: the mask is strong only where every channel lets the pixel through

presets.name: drawn + parametric (classic)
presets.description:
a "shapes" group (union) and a "parametric" group (multiply),
multiplied together, as a classic drawn & parametric mask did

notes: mask an area with parametric elements, and refine the selection with drawn shapes
with the multiply group operator, the masked area will be a smooth intersection of the area masked by both the parametric and the shapes group
use the difference group operator if you want to exclude the area masked by the shapes instead, or invert the output of the shapes group
start by selecting the parametric group and adding parametric channels to it, then move on to the shapes group

groups.name: shapes
notes: draw shapes here to limit the area affected by the parametric channels.
with the union operator, the pixels that belong to any of the shapes are masked
change the group operator to intersect if you want to select only the pixels that are covered by all shapes
change the group operator to screen if you want a union where feathered regions blend smoothly, or to multiply for a smoother intersection

groups.name: parametric
notes: add parametric channels here to select the area to mask, e.g., by color and brightness
with the multiply group operator, only the pixels that are selected by all parametric channels, e.g., pixels that are both red and low saturation, are masked
change the group operator to screen if you want to mask the pixels that are selected by any channel, e.g., red or low saturation pixels

presets.name: mask, intersect and subtract (advanced)
presets.description: a drawn + parametric mask, combined with a subtractive refinement

notes: subtract unwanted spillage from a drawn + parametric mask
start by creating a mask in the drawn + parametric group, then add elements here to clean up the spillage.
